name: Always Animate
description: Keeps animated profile pictures, banners, server icons, avatar decorations (ears), emoji, stickers, GIFs and nameplates playing, including in the chat. Works inside Discord's native chat, which normal plugins cannot reach.
author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: fluttershy_simper67 (the implementation: picture, emoji, sticker and cosmetic animation, the chat bridge and the native frame player for avatar decorations; Always Animate for Valenced 1.0.0-beta16)
AlwaysAnimate for Vencord by FieryFlames (the idea)
Found with the decompiled Discord app by Wumpus-Central (discord-mobile-datamining)
